title: Voice input: the chat box's microphone writes live words into the draft through tracy-web's speech relay, which enforces origin, session, one session per account, time, silence and minute limits
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (dependencies installed, a Chrome or Playwright Chromium available) run: node --test --test-timeout=120000 packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/e2e/voice-input.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/speech-relay.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/speech-route.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/voice-draft.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/voice-link.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/voice-pcm.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: 0 failures (the one live-service test is skipped without VOICE_E2E_REAL=1).
'dictation: words appear live in the draft, the language heard is shown, Done keeps them' passes: the draft reads 'Please: Đổi màu nền' mid-sentence, the badge reads VI, Done sends nothing.
'Enter while speaking: the last phrase is confirmed, then the message is sent once' passes.
'Escape takes the dictated words back out; the draft is as it was' and 'typing while speaking takes the draft back…' pass.
'a handshake is refused without a key (404), from another origin or site (403), and without a session (401)' passes, and nothing refused reaches the service.
'the first minute is counted before the service is called; over today’s budget, it never is' and 'a session ends after five minutes of audio (time-limit)…' pass.
'a page that is not a secure context (plain http): no microphone, since the browser offers none' passes.

'a phrase the service sends twice is told once, in either order; its copy only names the language' and 'a late copy of a finished phrase sent as a partial is dropped, so the phrase is never written twice' pass: the live service's order (stamped copy first) and its late partial never write a phrase twice.
evidence: 15/10/2026: speech to text in the chat box like Claude Design, live, in the language spoken (ElevenLabs Scribe). Live measurement and screenshots: tasks/evidence/voice-input-2026-10-15/.
fence: speechRelay in apps/tracy-web/src/speech/relay.js (admit, the limits, fromService pairing); draftWriter in packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/src/client/voice-draft.mjs; the secure-context and corner-shape rules found on the stand (VoiceInput.tsx usable, voice-styles.ts)

tests: a page that is not a secure context (plain http): no microphone, since the browser offers none
dictation: words appear live in the draft, the language heard is shown, Done keeps them
Enter while speaking: the last phrase is confirmed, then the message is sent once
Escape takes the dictated words back out; the draft is as it was
typing while speaking takes the draft back: the words stay, nothing is written over the typing
a handshake is refused without a key (404), from another origin or site (403), and without a session (401)
the first minute is counted before the service is called; over today’s budget, it never is
a session ends after five minutes of audio (time-limit), and each started minute is counted
a phrase the service sends twice is told once, in either order; its copy only names the language
a late copy of a finished phrase sent as a partial is dropped, so the phrase is never written twice
